scope: All-family structural audit; reused full-bank short-note metrics and current 30-check gate; 11 actual programs in supplemental captures. No subjective listening, native plugin qualification or field-recording match claim.

structural.name: Ring Bell
structural.description: A rounded wooden-mode body supports a short metallic upper mallet, then feeds the ring circuit. Hard strikes expose the upper clang; its rapid losses leave a softer resonating body behind. A gently open body, a defined attack and a clean key release.

structural.name: Laser Sweep
structural.description: A low body and later upper pulse bloom as the ring carrier rises, then falls over several seconds. Different filter and amplitude swells make the motion unfold in layers. A quick, forward edge that settles into a more compact body.

structural.name: Amber FX 137
structural.description: A steady 16' pulse motor supports a quieter upper mechanical buzz. A fixed 50 Hz ring carrier supplies sidebands, with a gradual start and a short coast after release. A warm main body with a slightly longer decay; the separate attack stays concise.

structural.name: Velvet FX 138
structural.description: An airy gust enters before the broad low wind bed. Independently paced smooth random filter and level motion forms uneven gusts, without a repeating SUB pulse; pressure raises the upper air, which subsides before the low bed. A covered upper register and rounded main release, preserving the shorter edge.

structural.name: Distant FX 139
structural.description: A very slow 16' sine bloom carries a later, cloudy noise band. Gentle sub-hertz ring beating and long independent releases leave a deep, moving tail. A subdued upper edge over a longer body ending; characteristic body detail remains present.

structural.name: Neon FX 140
structural.description: A high narrow pulse alternates pitches at 7 Hz, with a sharper 2' onset edge. Brief release and shallow level pulses keep the electronic signal dry and articulated. A forward attack color with a compact main decay and a separately controlled accent.

structural.name: Hollow FX 141
structural.description: A voiced ah-formant body carries a fixed 73 Hz mechanical ring, with a brief noisy saw consonant above it. The vocal resonances retain their shape across pitch changes; pressure opens and raises the sustained robotic vowel. A lightly focused filter band over a longer body, with restrained resonance on acoustic models.

structural.name: Golden FX 142
structural.description: Six-Hz retriggered envelopes make short mechanical ticks from a high pulse and thin noise edge. Each tick falls silent before the next; slower SUB filter steps alternate the tick-tock color, and held chords cycle through their keyed pitches. A gently open body, a defined attack and a clean key release.

structural.name: Frozen FX 143
structural.description: A continuous rain bed supports fine upper droplets. Fast raised-cosine random intensity contours combine with independent slower filter and level movement, keeping the rainfall fluid rather than switching the whole bed in clocked steps. Steadier tuning and a longer body decay, without stretching a separate short strike.

structural.name: Electric FX 144
structural.description: A resonant pulse sweep drops sharply after the strike, with no bypass sine masking the descent. A separate, very short noise flash adds the laser's initial snap. A quick, forward edge that settles into a more compact body.

structural.name: Midnight FX 145
structural.description: A dark 16' saw-and-sine foundation supports a later third-harmonic pulse. Slow ring beating and gentle filter drift animate the held drone without a sharp attack. A dark upper contour with a slightly lingering body; the onset remains defined.

structural.name: Slow FX 146
structural.description: A low body and later upper pulse bloom as the ring carrier rises, then falls over several seconds. Different filter and amplitude swells make the motion unfold in layers. A slower main entrance and longer ending, preserving the source's brief accents.

structural.name: Bright FX 147
structural.description: A resonant saw-and-noise body follows a short high noise scrape. The ring carrier falls quickly after impact, adding a rough metallic edge to the closing filter bands. A more open upper contour with a clear accent and slightly tighter main decay.

structural.name: Dark FX 148
structural.description: A brief broadband crack precedes a slower low rumble with a long falling tail. Smooth random intensity and spectral changes make the roll uneven without periodic pumping; broad low resonance avoids a fixed pitched boom, and velocity controls the impact. A covered upper contour with a tidy ending, retaining the instrument body's defining modes.

structural.name: Wide FX 149
structural.description: One breaking wave unfolds per note: the low surge rises first, brighter spray blooms later, and the foam drains away ahead of the long low wash. Independent one-shot envelopes shape the wave without a cyclic amplitude or filter pulse. Complementary ranks spread across stereo with a restrained, register-appropriate width and a centered composite image.

structural.name: Soft FX 150
structural.description: An 11 Hz sample-and-hold source picks resonant bubble colors while two independent smooth random level contours make the pops uneven in strength. A hollow pulse body and a little filtered noise keep their separate rounded and airy edges. A restrained upper contour and a cushioned main entrance; struck instruments retain their articulation.

structural.name: Amber FX 151

structural.name: Velvet FX 152

structural.name: Distant FX 153
structural.description: A low sine body follows repeating downward SUB glides while the shared ring carrier settles over the phrase. A subdued upper edge over a longer body ending; characteristic body detail remains present.
